transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Um, hi. I need to see Dr. Smith, I think I'm a new patient?
Of course. Could I have your full name and date of birth?
Marcus Oyelaran, that's O-Y-E-L-A-R-A-N. March third, ninety-one.
Thanks, Marcus. Are you a new or an existing patient?
Dr. Smith can see you Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM.
Do you have anything Friday? I'm off work then.
Yes, Friday at 2 PM is open. Shall I book that?
Booked for Friday at 2 PM. Goodbye.
